PartyCreditPrflFinclAcct.name: PartyCreditPrflFinclAcct
PartyCreditPrflFinclAcct.description: Represents information about financial accounts, such as a credit card, an auto loan, or a mortgage account, reported by a credit bureau. Helps lenders to review the details of a borrower's accounts, both active and inactive.

AccountBalance.description: The outstanding balance on the financial account.

AccountNumber.description: The identifier of the financial account.

AccountOwnership.description: The ownership of the financial account.

ApprovedAmount.description: The credit limit approved by the lender.

ClosingDate.description: The date when the financial account was closed.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed this record.

MonthsReviewed.description: The number of months reviewed for the credit report.

NinetyDayDelinquencyCount.description: The number of times a payment has been 90 days late.

OpeningDate.description: The date when the financial account was opened.

PartyCreditProfileId.description: The party credit profile associated with the Financial Account.

PaymentFrequency.description: The payment frequency for the financial account.

ReportingDate.description: The date when the financial account was reported to the credit bureau.

SixtyDayDelinquencyCount.description: The number of times a payment has been 60 days late.

Status.description: The current status of the financial account.

TermDurationInMonths.description: The duration of the credit in months.

ThirtyDayDelinquencyCount.description: The number of times a payment has been 30 days late.

Type.description: The type of financial account, such as a credit card, home loan, or auto loan.
